days.heading: Tuesday 13 October
days.alt: Delegates talking over drinks at the NEDC welcome reception
body: NEDC26 begins with immersive study tours, taking delegates beyond the conference room and into the places, industries and ideas shaping Tasmania's future.
Day one closes with the NEDC26 Welcome Reception, a chance to reconnect with national colleagues, meet new peers and ease into the conference with conversation, connection and Tasmanian hospitality.

sessions.name: Renewables, Green Economy and Advanced Manufacturing

days.heading: Wednesday 14 October
days.note: Plenaries, keynotes and the Awards Gala Dinner
days.alt: A full plenary audience seated in Hobart City Hall
body: Day two launches the main conference program with plenary sessions, keynote presentations and expert panels exploring the ideas, opportunities and leadership challenges shaping the future of places across Australia.

sessions.name: Community engagement and influencing decision makers
National Economic Development Awards for Excellence Gala Dinner

days.heading: Thursday 15 October
days.note: Keynotes, masterclasses, workshops and a live debate
days.alt: Four panellists in conversation on stage at NEDC
body: Day three builds on the momentum, translating big ideas into practical frameworks, tools and approaches. A mix of strategic insight, practical learning and interactive discussion leaves delegates ready to take new ideas back to their communities.

sessions.name: Place based economies and the Shorefast approach
Economic development career pathways and leadership

days.heading: Friday 16 October
days.alt: Gallery buildings on the Derwent River at Berriedale, north of Hobart
body: Extend your NEDC26 experience with the post conference study tour, focused on Hobart's creative and cultural economy. It explores how arts, culture, heritage and community spaces contribute to Greater Hobart's identity, liveability and long term prosperity.
